full_judgment:
3. The learned Assistant Judge upon hearing the parties by judgment and order dated 4th October, 2003 rejected the petition. The plaintiff thereupon unsuccessfully moved the learned District Judge, Chittagong in Miscellaneous Appeal No. 211 of 2003 and then the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 273 of 2004. We have heard the learned Counsel for the petitioner and perused the judgment of the High Court Division and those of the Courts below. 

 4. On perusal of the judgments we find that the High Court Division has rightly held that the plaintiff petitioner has no prima facie title in the suit land and that the Courts below have rightly rejected the prayer for temporary injunction. We are satisfied that the petitioner has prosecuted a frivolous application who has no prima facie right, title and interest in the suit land and therefore his prayer for temporary injunction has been rightly rejected by the courts below. There is no merit in this leave petition.
